The '''''Corrupter''''' was a [[Victory II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory II''-class Star Destroyer]] in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==History==
Prior to the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], the ''Corrupter'' was assigned by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] to hunt down [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] and [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]. Following the cataclysmic defeat at [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] and the schism of the Imperial ranks, this ship was reassigned to the personal [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] [[Director/Legends|Director]] [[Ysanne Isard]].

Isard used the ''Corrupter'' to defend [[Thyferra/Legends|Thyferra]] and [[Xucphra Corporation|Xucphra]] [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]] convoys following her flight from [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Ait Convarion]], the ship's commanding officer, found and destroyed a bacta-hauling [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] stolen by members of [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]]&mdash;many members of the squad were killed as a result.

After this incident, the ''Corrupter'' began terrorizing worlds that refused to pay Isard's largely inflated prices for bacta, especially those that received free bacta "liberated" by the Rogues. The ''Corrupter''{{'s}} first target in this campaign was to destroy a colony on [[Halanit]]. The ship's [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE/sa bombers]] conducted an orbital bombardment using [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonators]] and [[Proton bomb/Legends|proton bombs]] to melt the glacier and open a hole in the colony's roof. [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE interceptors]] and [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] then attacked the colony in order to kill its people.

The ''Corrupter'' would, however, meet her end at [[the Graveyard]]. With the aid of the [[Immobilizer 418 Interdictor-class Heavy Cruiser|Immobilizer 418 cruiser]] ''[[Aggregator]]'', the ''Corrupter''{{'s}} captain thought that he had the Rogues in an inescapable trap&mdash;until the sudden appearance of the [[Valiant (Thranta-class War Cruiser)|''Valiant'']], which attacked the unshielded portion of the destroyer.

The [[Valiant (Thranta-class War Cruiser)|''Valiant'']], a [[Thranta-class War Cruiser|Thantra-Class War Cruiser]], had originally been assigned to escort the [[Alderaanian War Frigate]], [[Another Chance]], which had been turned into an armory ship to carry the planet's weapons away when they disarmed. However, the Valiant became separated from the convoy and the ship's automated crew decided to return to the planet for updated orders; orders that would never come, due the the [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|Destruction of Alderaan]]. 

At that time, Rogue Squadron was acting without the official backing of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] government, and so had chosen to use [[Identify Friend/Foe transponder|IFF beacon]] codes from their home planets, rather than the official New Republic frequency. [[Tycho Celchu/Legends|Tycho Celchu]], a native of Alderaan, had chosen to use a pre-disarmament military code, which happened to correspond to the beacon of Another Chance. The [[Droid/Legends|droid]] crew of the ship had interpreted the battle as an attack on their programmed charge, despite the fact that the beacon was now attached to a [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-Wing fighter.]]

After suffering a considerable amount of damage from the squadron and the Valiant, a pair of [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedoes]] fired by [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] struck the [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]], killing Captain Convarion. The leaderless [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ship]] was soon abandoned. The Rogues and smugglers were unable to salvage the ''Corrupter'', and it was destroyed by the Graveyard's [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]].
